description: This file provides template declarations and specializations for a subset of cuSPARSE functions related to sparse matrix operations in CUDA, within the at::cuda::sparse namespace. It includes function prototypes for buffer size calculations, matrix addition, multiplication, and solving systems, with implementations marked as not yet implemented for generic types.

methods.name: csrgeam2_bufferSizeExt
methods.description: Template function to compute buffer size for sparse matrix addition, not implemented for generic types.

methods.name: csrgeam2Nnz
methods.description: Computes the number of non-zero elements in the result of sparse matrix addition.

methods.name: csrgeam2
methods.description: Performs sparse matrix addition; not implemented for generic types.

methods.name: bsrmm
methods.description: Performs BSR matrix-matrix multiplication; not implemented for generic types.

methods.name: bsrmv
methods.description: Performs BSR matrix-vector multiplication; not implemented for generic types.

methods.name: bsrsv2_bufferSize
methods.description: Computes buffer size for BSR sparse triangular solve; not implemented for generic types.

methods.name: bsrsv2_analysis
methods.description: Analyzes BSR sparse triangular solve; not implemented for generic types.

methods.name: bsrsv2_solve
methods.description: Solves BSR sparse triangular systems; not implemented for generic types.

methods.name: bsrsm2_bufferSize
methods.description: Computes buffer size for BSR sparse matrix solve; not implemented for generic types.

methods.name: bsrsm2_analysis
methods.description: Analyzes BSR sparse matrix solve; not implemented for generic types.

methods.name: bsrsm2_solve
methods.description: Performs BSR sparse matrix solve; not implemented for generic types.
